subject: RECORD KEY clause
notes: LANDED 2026-09-06 (kb/Work PB743) - the CATEGORY arm, which is what earns the verdict PB699 deliberately withheld. RULE (--check 12.4.5.12.3 2): "Data-name-1 and data-name-2 shall reference a data item of category alphanumeric or category national within a record description entry associated with the file-name specified in this file control entry." ONE sentence, TWO obligations joined by the word "within": a CATEGORY and a LOCATION. PB699 implemented the LOCATION half and left the row without a verdict rather than over-claiming; measured with only that half live, an indexed file whose RECORD KEY was PIC 9(5) compiled clean, ran, and wrote '00' - it built an index on an operand the standard forbids as a key. Now TWO ROWS carry this rule-id, one per arm, and FileControlKeyRuleDriftTests.ARuleWithTwoObligations_HasARowForEachArm re-derives the split FROM THE PRINTED SENTENCE so a rule that grows a third obligation reddens instead of shipping two thirds. The category predicate is ItemCategory.IsAlphanumericOrNational - the ONE 8.5.2 category reader, extracted from DataBinder in the same change and now shared with 12.4.5.2 SR7's ASSIGN ... USING screen - which admits an alphanumeric group item (13.18.29.4 GR3: "If a GROUP-USAGE clause is not specified or implied ... that group item is an alphanumeric group item") and a GROUP-USAGE NATIONAL group, and refuses alphabetic (PicInfo.IsAlphabetic; the storage model folds PIC A into PicCategory.Alphanumeric, so a bare category comparison would have passed it), numeric, numeric-edited, boolean and the PICTURE-less usages. Alphanumeric-edited has no PicCategory member and is therefore admitted - the established posture for a category screen here (RecordLayout.CategoryOfItem, 14.9.41.3 SR6 b) 2.): the screen rejects what the rule NAMES, never what the model cannot classify. DATA-NAME-2 is the SOURCE phrase's operand and has no reachable spelling (docs/CONFORMANCE.md 2 row 40 declines A.3 item 40), and SR2's third sentence ("All occurrences of data-name-2 shall be of the same category") is about it alone. kb/Work PB1099 Q1 (w1095i): the record-key SOURCE phrase is PROVIDED (owner rule R65); the data-name-2 arms, the last sentence ("All occurrences of data-name-2 shall be of the same category") included, screened per operand.
